name: DraftKings

news.headline: Florida's attorney general joins the Seminole suit against DraftKings
news.summary: The AG moved to intervene in the Tribe's action seeking to shut down DraftKings' prediction-market, 21 Rivals and Pick6 products in Florida, arguing it operates illegal sportsbooks under the guise of an approved financial product — a second regulatory front in the state that matters most to the prediction-markets thesis.

news.headline: Three insiders spent $1.45m after the post-earnings slump
news.summary: Ellingson, Wendt and Kalish bought 78,908 Class A shares between $18.22 and $19.76 in the days after the 21.3% cut-on-guidance drop; the stock touched a one-year $15.43 on Tuesday and remains 48% below its 1 December 2025 close of $33.87.

flags: A Deadspin report that CEO Jason Robins and the CFO bought ~$2m and ~$1m is not supported by the Form 4 filings; Robins has reported no trade since 15 September.
